title.narrative: Innovative Model Combining Block Farming and a Digital Platform to Enable a Sustainable Pineapple Supply Chain

description.narrative: This model combines block-farming with a Digital Extension Tools. On a 50ha block-farm, 250 farmers will be hired to work on their own 0,5 acre plot, creating stable jobs for 20-30% women and 40-50% youth.
